name: Sol Renn
title: Noon Fire
description: A rooftop cook who fights at lunch-rush pace. Heat, then a plate in your face.
source_description: Male fighter, athletic, sun-bleached hair, orange apron wrap, fierce personality, fire-based powers.
special_desc: A two-hit fire wave that keeps pressure on block.
ultimate_desc: Detonates the kitchen at close range.
